compareMethod: For each of 4,344 UTC H1 hours exactly match 12 contiguous 5m bars; compare H1 open/high/low/close/volume to M5 first-open/max-high/min-low/last-close/sum-volume with absolute relative tolerance 1e-5 * max(1,abs(x),abs(y)). Distinct source aggregation rules may legitimately differ; no interpolation or substitution.
limitations: Comparing two ASTER-named local archives does not prove their actual venue provenance or shared aggregation specification
Many H1 vs M5 discrepancies can reflect distinct feed construction, especially sparse H1 opening trades, not necessarily invalid individual OHLC
Exactly one H1 and one M5 candle are internally invalid in this window; no cross-venue or arithmetic repair allowed
Cannot infer orders, fills, venue liquidity, funding, STOP, portfolio Gross, DD, or full Q102 native strategy parity
84 price discrepancies are associated with zero-volume first 5m candles; they are NOT automatically malformed H1 candles or reason to reject the entire 181-day H1 signal history
Do not use zero-volume M5 candle open as an executable fill or automatically correct H1 from these 5m bars

mismatchSegmentation.interpretation: 84/85 H1-M5 OHLC mismatches coincide with the first M5 candle having ZERO volume, and all 84 opening-price mismatches do. This supports a sparse no-trade candle opening convention difference, but exact vendor source semantics remain unverified. The remaining 1 is the internally invalid 2025-09-13 H1/M5 source hour.
